module_summary: Synchronous FIFO wrapper that adds a registered threshold interrupt, predicting next fill level from accepted writes/reads and comparing it to i_threshold.

anchors.name: i_wr
anchors.why: Write request into the FIFO; accepted when not full.

anchors.name: i_data
anchors.why: Write data stored in the child FIFO.

anchors.name: i_rd
anchors.why: Read request popping the FIFO; accepted when not empty.

anchors.name: o_data
anchors.why: Read data from the child FIFO.

anchors.name: o_fill
anchors.why: FIFO occupancy count used to compute the threshold interrupt.

anchors.name: o_int
anchors.why: Registered interrupt asserted when next fill level reaches i_threshold.

anchors.name: i_threshold
anchors.why: Fill threshold compared against predicted fill to raise o_int.

anchors.name: w_wr
anchors.why: Accepted write, adjusting predicted fill in interrupt logic.

anchors.name: w_rd
anchors.why: Accepted read, adjusting predicted fill in interrupt logic.

groups.name: fifo_core
groups.description: Child synchronous FIFO with memory, pointers and fill counter.

groups.name: threshold_irq
groups.description: Compares predicted next fill level with threshold to register interrupt.
